title.en: An Act Amending Section Two of Republic Act Numbered Twenty-Six Hundred Fifty-Nine By Increasing the Bed Capacity of Palompon General Hospital, and Authorizing the Appropriation of Additional Funds Therefor.

text.en:
Section two of Republic Act Numbered twenty-six hundred fifty-nine is hereby amended to read as follows:
"

There is hereby authorized to be appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, the sum of one hundred fifty thousand pesos for the construction of the Palompon General Hospital and for its operation and maintenance: Provided: That this hospital shall have at least seventy-five beds."
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
